resources.string: Register existing folders inside the configured download directories. Quality folders are hidden. Choose a folder in the download dialog, or keep the default rules.
Add folders in Plugins → Save folders.
The default directory changed. Register this folder again.
Lower first uses enabled upper bounds; upper first uses enabled lower bounds. Values outside the chosen direction remain in the base folder. Video codec, FPS and bitrate criteria still apply.
Mark one folder as Quick. Tap it in the download window to apply it immediately; tap again to use the default rules.
